secondFactor.help: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
secondFactor.recoveryHelp: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each one works once.
secondFactor.expired: This sign-in expired. Enter your password again.

recoveryCodes.title: Recovery codes
recoveryCodes.warning: Keep these codes somewhere safe, such as a password manager. They are shown only once and each works once, if you lose your authenticator app.
recoveryCodes.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the codes and copy them by hand.
recoveryCodes.fileHeader: Meshloom recovery codes. Each code works once. Keep this file private.

totp.passwordHelp: Confirm your password to set up two-factor authentication.
totp.scanHelp: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, or enter the key by hand. The code is drawn in this browser; the key never leaves your Meshloom.
totp.codeOrRecovery: An authenticator code or an unused recovery code.
totp.codeOnly: An authenticator code (a recovery code does not work here).

enrolmentRequired.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enrolmentRequired.description: The administrator requires two-factor authentication for administrators. Set it up to carry on.

security.title: Two-factor authentication
security.ingress: Two-factor authentication does not apply under Home Assistant: Home Assistant already signed you in and handles your login security.
security.noPassword: This account has no Meshloom password (it signs in another way), so it has no second factor.
security.off: Two-factor authentication is off. Add a second step to your sign-in with an authenticator app.
security.pending: A setup was started but not finished. Starting again replaces it.
security.requireHelp: An administrator with a password who has not set it up can do nothing but set it up. Members and viewers are not affected.
security.requireOwnFirst: Set up your own second factor first, or you will be asked to as soon as you turn this on.
security.requireOff: Two-factor authentication is no longer required for administrators.
